about: Jacket landmarks read off the period photographs (PHOTOS.md) in each original's own pixels, through tools/photo_grid.py overlays, 7 October 2026. Read by eye on a 25 or 50 px grid: about +/-10 px on front-04 (1890 x 2474), +/-15 px on front-02 (2000 x 1437, read at 0.7 scale). L = vertical distance from the mean neck point (collar's outer edge meeting the shoulder line) to the hem at the side. Ratios: shoulder width / L (points at the sleeve head's top; no correction for the body's turn), notch below the neck point / L, top fastened button below the neck point / L, shoulder line's fall from the neck point (degrees, collar included).
side: No true profile survives the licence and age checks (PHOTOS.md). side-03's right-hand man (rear three-quarter) and side-04 (three-quarter) show only that the hem runs level to slightly lower at the front and the back falls straight from the blades; no ratio is read from them.
precision: Four men, three photographs: the photographs give bands, not one exact target. Each band is wider than its reading error, so it reflects real variety in cut, build and pose.
